results.rationale: Consistency: the gray fluted-column style and receding row remain, but the background changes from light gray to white, the column spacing/framing changes, and shaft/base proportions are altered. Instruction: eight columns remain visible; the expected result is exactly five columns, so the requested count change is absent. Quality: satisfactory structure, lighting, clean edges and surface shading; the stylized architectural row has no noticeable visual artifacts.

Consistency: the bed, chair, window, curtains and wall carving retain their broad arrangement, but room colors become cooler and darker and the carving, bedding and rug textures are visibly altered. Instruction: two red balloons have been added above the bed; the expected result is one regular-air balloon in the room. Adding balloons addresses the main idea, but the number and unsupported elevated placement are incorrect. Knowledge: the supplied explanation requires the balloon to lie on the floor; both balloons are elevated above the bed, contradicting that physical expectation entirely. Quality: overall room structure is recognizable, but pervasive rippled/embossed distortion affects the bedding, wall ornament, branches and rug, with unnatural edge halos and degraded surface textures.
